notes: The first isnad has no compiler's teacher in the text and starts at «قال مجاهد»; «وسئل ابن عباس» has Ibn Abbas answer, so he is the last link (rule 11: the one asked and answering is settled).
«قال حدثنا بذلك هناد» starts a second isnad for the same saying (rule 4); «ومعنى الحديث» is Tirmidhi's commentary, not a link.
